protectedRehearsal.backupRestore: protected non-empty Staging backup created and isolated restore passed; live database was not migrated
protectedRehearsal.functionalProbes: required on the restored non-empty application data; transactional synthetic probes only, no provider traffic
protectedRehearsal.servicesAfterPass: all quiesced services remain stopped; controlled synthetic acceptance must pass before an explicit exact-new-API release step
protectedRehearsal.cleanup: isolated container and volume removal is verified; any removal/absence-check failure overrides PASS and requires recovery

priorImageSqlContractComparison.rule: compare the prior image SQL/runtime contract with migrations 075-087 before any shared Staging forward attempt; health/readiness cannot substitute

protectedRehearsal.filesystemAndQuiesceInvariant: validate every existing backup path component (lstat/realpath/owner/mode, no symlink or repository escape) before creating anything; validate the complete Staging container/service label set before stopping any container; check foreign writers immediately before and after pg_dump
protectedRehearsal.failureEvidence: sanitized mode-0600 fail-closed report retains quiesced service state; services are not resumed after an unsuccessful rehearsal

requiredSourceConfig.mfa: server-side MFA encryption/secret configuration must already be present; values are not recorded
requiredSourceConfig.mfaComposeGap: resolved in the Staging MFA overlay; base compose remains provider-neutral and never receives a raw key

mfaConfigPlan.injection: MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE is supplied by compose.staging.mfa.yml from an owner-only external file; direct raw environment injection is forbidden
mfaConfigPlan.preflight: validate_mfa_staging_secret.mjs checks presence, path, permissions and strict 32-byte shape without printing or persisting the value
mfaConfigPlan.rotation: keep the key stable for existing TOTP ciphertext; ensure_mfa_staging_secret.mjs reuses a valid external file and creates only with exact confirmation/O_EXCL when absence is proven; it never overwrites, rotates or prints the key

Keep IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_TRANSPORT=disabled; do not mount provider secrets
Read back /version, /health and /health/ready plus authenticated MFA and identity status
Verify the returned status is truthful and no 404 remains for source routes
